notes.title: New hotel area and a new girl
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Here is what we have added in today's patch:

-New area of the hotel, the restaurant opens its doors!

-New girl, welcome Tsubomi an expert in the kitchen!

-Bugs and text corrections.

We hope you enjoy the new possibilities we have added. We will continue working to improve and add content that will leave you wanting more. Thanks to all of you.
